title: Strict A/B/C report refuses a uniform wrong base SHA or an unknown model
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: evals/replay/abc.ts:169-172 check only mixed harness and missing model; a uniformly wrong SHA or unknown model passes.
Outcome: --report --strict exits 65 when every row uses a SHA other than the preregistered one or a model outside the pinned set.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer fails before the fix and passes after.
